verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly a terminal-based open-source AI coding agent (gemini-cli-gh-23) with strong first-party docs on running locally, editing codebases, non-interactive scripting, and MCP/tool integration, corroborated by extensive hands-on community use (some positive, some critical of quality but not of the core capability existing). missing for 10: no independent benchmark of reliability across environments beyond mixed anecdotal reports.
